title: La durée
subtitle: Duration: il y a, depuis, pendant, pour
review: Imported from the old fundamentals pages with their recordings. The level is a guess.

groups.title: "Il y a" - ago
groups.sub: Indicates that something happened a certain time ago

words.fr: C'était il y a plus de deux ans.
words.en: It was more than two years ago.
words.audio: 02-C'était il y a plus de deux ans.m4a

words.fr: Il y a trois jours, nous sommes rentrés d'Europe.
words.en: Three days ago, we came back from Europe.
words.audio: 03-Il y a trois jours, nous sommes rentrés d'Europe.m4a

words.fr: On s'est rencontrés il y a 7 ans.
words.audio: 04-On s'est rencontrés il y a 7 ans.m4a

notes: Structure: il y a + duration/time + past tense

groups.title: "Depuis" - since / for
groups.sub: Refers to an action that started in the past and is still ongoing

words.fr: On est mariés depuis vingt-trois ans.

words.en: Have you been here a long time?
I have had it for years.

words.fr: Je savais qu'elle mentait depuis le début.
words.en: I know she was lying from the start.
words.audio: 11-Je savais qu'elle mentait depuis le début.m4a

words.fr: Je le dis depuis le début.
words.en: I have been saying that since the beginning.

words.fr: Je suis levée depuis six heures.
words.en: I have been up since 6 o'clock.

groups.title: "Pendant" - for / during
groups.sub: Describes the entire duration of a completed action

words.en: I was a primary school teacher for 25 years.

words.fr: Tu fais quoi pendant tout ça ?
words.en: What are you doing during all this?

groups.title: "Pour" - for
groups.sub: Used when talking about the duration of a future event

words.en: We are going away for a month.

groups.title: "Depuis que" - since / ever since
groups.sub: As a conjunction - introduces a clause to show when an action began

groups.title: "Ça fait... que" - It's been...that
groups.sub: Similar to "il y a," this expression emphasizes the duration of time

words.fr: Ça fait des années que j'attends.
Ça fait 30 ans que j'y habite.
words.en: I've been living here for 30 years.

words.fr: Ça fait longtemps que ça dure ?
words.en: Has it been going on for a long time?

words.fr: Ça fait longtemps que je l'ai pas vue.
words.en: It's been a long time since I saw her.
words.audio: 30-Ça fait longtemps que je l'ai pas vue.m4a
